$comment: The grammar leg's skip register: parse-kind cases whose rejection lives outside the grammar layer's reach. EMPTY as of suite 3.10.0 — the per-construct typed surface in grammar/primmel.parg (the dispatch, the required-value badness predicates, the closed facet vocabularies, the scoped sub-block dispatch with sub-keyword-excluded bares) carried the kernel's per-construct parse discipline for every corpus case then in the suite. The register only shrinks and may only be repopulated with a reason a future case proves; the leg errors on a stale entry (a case that agrees without the skip), on an entry naming a case that no longer exists, and on a disagreement whose case is not registered.

skips.reason: the retired step-level executor facet is refused by the kernel's per-construct step-body parse discipline (a closed facet vocabulary of the step body); the PG grammar's process block is the open item stream and cannot express the scoped step dispatch yet — the grammar-side enforcement (a scoped does-block step rule with a badness predicate) is the recorded reopen trigger (TODO.lang-gaps/05)

the retired form-field calculation_bindings facet is refused by the kernel's per-construct field-body parse discipline (a closed facet vocabulary of the field body); the PG grammar's form block is the open item stream and cannot express the scoped field dispatch yet — the grammar-side enforcement (a scoped field-body rule with a badness predicate) is the recorded reopen trigger (TODO.lang-gaps/01)

THE PROSE QUARANTINE (C158) refuses the bare quoted-string spelling of the five prose facets in the kernel's per-construct facet readers; the PG grammar's open block structure reads any quoted token as a legal facet value — the grammar-side enforcement (per-construct badness predicates over the five facets) is the recorded reopen trigger (TODO.lang-gaps/02)

the boolean-verdict fold's first retirement (TODO.lang-gaps/03) refuses the form's pass_fail block and the acceptance_criteria pass_if facet in the kernel's per-construct facet readers; the PG grammar's open form and acceptance_criteria blocks read the retired spellings as legal facet items — the grammar-side enforcement (scoped pass_fail/pass_if badness predicates) is the recorded reopen trigger (TODO.lang-gaps/03)

the boolean-verdict fold's last retirement (TODO.lang-gaps/03) refuses the validate_measurement facet in the kernel's per-construct facet readers of both homes (the workflow process and the conformance test); the PG grammar's open process and conformance_test blocks read the retired spelling as a legal facet block — the grammar-side enforcement (scoped validate_measurement badness predicates) is the recorded reopen trigger (TODO.lang-gaps/03)

the retired acceptance_criteria block is refused by the kernel's per-construct facet readers (both carriers); the PG grammar's open block structure reads any block as a legal facet value — the grammar-side enforcement (per-construct badness predicates) is the recorded reopen trigger (TODO.lang-gaps/03)
